==================
async as a contextual parameter and value identifier
==================

class C { int M(bool async) => async ? 1 : 0; }

---

(compilation_unit
  (class_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    body: (declaration_list
      (method_declaration
        returns: (predefined_type)
        name: (identifier)
        parameters: (parameter_list
          (parameter
            type: (predefined_type)
            name: (identifier)))
        body: (arrow_expression_clause
          (conditional_expression
            condition: (identifier)
            consequence: (integer_literal)
            alternative: (integer_literal)))))))

==================
async as an implicit lambda parameter
==================

class C { object M() { return async => async; } }

---

(compilation_unit
  (class_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    body: (declaration_list
      (method_declaration
        returns: (predefined_type)
        name: (identifier)
        parameters: (parameter_list)
        body: (block
          (return_statement
            (lambda_expression
              parameters: (implicit_parameter)
              body: (identifier))))))))
